previousDefinition: A medical procedure in which part of the electrical conduction system of a tumor or other dysfunctional tissue is ablated using the heat generated from high-frequency alternating current.
definition: A procedure that delivers radiofrequency energy through electrodes to heat and destroy abnormal tissue.
reason: The source wording incorrectly attributed an electrical conduction system to a tumor. The revised description uses NCI's documented heat-destruction mechanism and does not combine tumor treatment with cardiac conduction-system anatomy.
